actionable_steps.citation: Recognise The Fundamental Principle Of Oneness — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-03-21
actionable_steps.step: Contemplate the one divinity permeating all forms — forget the diversity, contemplate the divinity.

actionable_steps.citation: Recognise the principle of 'I' — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 32 (1999), 1999-08-05
actionable_steps.step: When someone criticises you, don't get agitated — remember the same Atmic principle is present in both of you.

actionable_steps.citation: Prema and the triple purity — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-01-14
actionable_steps.step: Achieve unity of thought, word and deed — that is the hallmark of humanness and the essence of Vedanta.

actionable_steps.citation: All Are Embodiments of Brahman (Alternative Translation) — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-30
actionable_steps.step: Develop the feeling of oneness (ekatma bhava) through constant practice — the same Atma is in you, in Me, and in everyone.

actionable_steps.citation: Seeing Unity In Diversity Is True Spirituality — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 41 (2008), 2008-05-31
actionable_steps.step: Talk smilingly to others and develop the spirit of unity — let hatred, anger and greed leave you.

definition.citation: Cells of the body of God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 12 (1973 - 74), 1974-03-01
definition.quote: They are ONE Atma. … Vasudhaiva kutumbakam, as the Shasthras (moral codes) declare, "the whole world is one family."

discourses.citation: Recognise The Fundamental Principle Of Oneness — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-03-21
discourses.quote: This world has a plethora of forms but there is one divinity, which permeates all these forms. Know this truth. … Ekam sath viprah bahudha vadanti. Truth is one but wise men call it by many names.

discourses.citation: Recognise the principle of 'I' — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 32 (1999), 1999-08-05
discourses.quote: Remember that the same Atmic principle is present in both of you. The one who accuses and the one who is accused are not two different entities. … Peace and serenity will reign supreme in the world once this principle of oneness is recognised.

discourses.citation: Prema and the triple purity — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-01-14
discourses.quote: True humanness consists in the unity of thought, word and deed. … "Manasyekam, vachasyekam, karmanyekam mahatmanam" (Those whose mind, words and deeds are in complete accord are high-souled beings).

discourses.citation: All Are Embodiments of Brahman (Alternative Translation) — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-30
discourses.quote: Castes are many but humanity is one. Beings are many but Atma is one. … Therefore, you should go beyond this state of Brotherhood of Man and develop the feeling of oneness (ekatma bhava).

make_it_real: The same Atma breathes in you and in the person who annoys you most — act like it today.
title: Unity of Mankind
